command.name: e2e-probe
command.body:
Do these steps in order, one tool call each, then reply with the single word done.
1. Run the Bash command `echo e2e-ok`.
2. Run the Bash command `ls nonexistent-e2e-path` (it is expected to fail).
3. Invoke the Skill tool with skill `e2e-skill`.
4. Use the Agent tool (subagent_type general-purpose) with the prompt: Run the Bash command `echo e2e-sub` and reply done.

skill.name: e2e-skill
skill.body:
---
name: e2e-skill
description: E2E probe skill. Use only when asked explicitly.
---
Reply with the single word skill-ok.

args: Reply with the single word ok.

leak.prompt: Run the Bash command `echo {sentinel}` once, then reply done.
